title: Huge breakthrough on my BTC hourly prediction agent…. Profitability factor at .71X.
author: Four_0_one_k

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: hold the live money a week. the number would not worry me, what would is that one tweak took the same 12 months from a loss to a big win. when a single change flips the whole sample, the change usually learned the sample rather than the market. freeze it and run the next couple hundred hourlies paper, Kalshi settles fast so that is two or three weeks and you will know. and 10 percent stake per market means a normal run of 8 wrong in a row cuts the account by more than half, which ends most of these before the edge ever gets a chance to show up.

replies.author: Four_0_one_k
replies.body: I totally agree, but I wasn’t at a loss. I was at roughly “\~” 35% for the last month. One tweak doubled it. I’m currently testing live with $25 stakes but only a few days in. Will provide updates as I have them. I’ll share the edge because I think others could benefit from it. I only triggered set ups that occurred where the identified target was at a specified distance from the recognition point *and* when the target wouldn’t be reached until the following hour, all trades placed in the first candle of the hour, before slippage from others predictions identifying the same opportunity crowd the position

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: $25 stakes for a few days is the right size for this stage. thirty five to seventy on one filter is what i'd want to see hold on hourlies the filter has never met, a couple hundred of them and you'll know either way. looking forward to the write-up.

replies.author: Four_0_one_k
replies.body: Yes, you got it wrong… it’s not -30% it’s \~30%. Also .7x is the same as 70%, which is extremely profitable

replies.author: LatterRain5
replies.body:
A profit factor of 0.71x is not profitable. In trading, a strategy is actively losing money any time the profit factor drops below 1.0.

Maybe u are saying 1.7x instead. Any profit factor below 1 is negative.

replies.author: Four_0_one_k
replies.body: Definitely encouraging. But just backtesting results so far. I did everything to rule out any bias. Ran various periods of historical data, chopped up the past year into randomly shuffled 15 minute periods since the edge is based primarily on pattern recognition to confirm the edge disappeared and all results were supportive of a greater than 71% return. (43% with the top 10% of winning predictions removed), but the live results will be the true test. Will have a solid amount of data later this month and post the results.
